about: The weekly pass's news digests (tools/kb/meta.py, read by wowstats.news), newest first: the newest 8 weeks in full; an older week keeps only its items announcing an event still to come. tools/kb/lifecycle.py compacts the rest into digest-history.json.

items.title: More caster gear planned
items.text: Developers say spell power gear is too scarce at levels 15–40 and promise more of it in future patches.

items.title: Raid wings get biomes
items.text: Designers want gear chosen per fight. In the raid, one wing is snowy and another is haunted, and items are tuned to creature types and biomes rather than to one BiS list.

items.title: Unstable Magic motes soulbound
items.text: Since 19 Nov, Motes of Unstable Magic can no longer be traded or sold on the Auction House, which ends a popular gold earner.

items.title: EU battleground queues stuck
items.text: Some EU players say battleground queues never pop on certain layers. Moving to another layer, for example through a friend's group, may get around it.

items.title: Three quests under investigation
items.text: Blizzard is investigating three quests: Call of Earth not teaching Stoneskin Totem to Skyborne shamans, Ti'ik's Head dropping for only one group member, and Biding Our Time giving an unusable cloak.

items.title: 19 Nov hotfixes
items.text: Ret's two-hand talent now boosts all Holy damage. The Seed Hybridizer is back, with a failure chance. Motes are now soulbound, and fixes went in for City of Dalaran, Shaper's Terrace and Cultivation.

items.title: Skyborne riding discount for all
items.text: After the 19 Nov fix, every Skyborne seems to get 10% off riding skills, Rare and Epic included, whatever their reputation; it is unclear whether this is intended.

items.title: Layer-targeting addons ending
items.text: A coming 1.60.1 hotfix hides realm IDs from the game's data, so addons such as Layer Swap can no longer pick a specific layer.

items.title: Crafted tier stats revealed
items.text: Stats for the crafted tier pieces of the first raid tier are now visible, with only one crafted piece usable at a time. Set bonuses are placeholders, and the raids launch 9 Dec.

event.name: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open

items.title: 20 Nov hotfixes
items.text: Each dungeon now allows five resets and re-entries per hour (was ten). Blade Flurry now cleaves Shank, the Demonic Aegis exploit is fixed, Stormshroud Armor is nerfed, and the group-finder bug that hid groups is fixed.

items.title: Instance cap hits fast farms
items.text: The five hourly resets per dungeon affect repeated solo clears that take less than 12 minutes.

items.title: World buffs lost on loading
items.text: An undocumented change strips world buffs at every loading screen (logins, hearths, dungeons, other continent), so they currently only last in the open world.

items.title: Uldaman Sentinel loot removed
items.text: The Obsidian Sentinel in Uldaman no longer drops blue gear, which ends a quick gold farm and blocks the Pendulum of Doom.

items.title: Lockbox peeking removed
items.text: Opening a lockbox now loots everything straight into your bags; this closes an exploit that rerolled its contents.

items.title: World buff loss is a bug
items.text: Zirene confirmed that losing world buffs on loading screens is a bug, with a fix due 23 Nov.

items.title: Hotfixes for 19–20 November
items.text: Each dungeon now allows five resets and re-entries per hour, down from ten. Blade Flurry spreads Shank to one extra target. Demonic Aegis drops when untalented. Stormshroud's three-piece bonus now gives 18 energy on a 3% proc.
items.author: Blizzard staff

items.title: Dungeon quest items shared round-robin
items.text: Quest items in dungeons now drop round-robin across the party, and a few dungeon quests (Wailing Caverns, Blackfathom Deeps, City of Dalaran) still take more than one run.

items.title: Enhancement shaman reworked
items.text: Stormstrike now hits for full weapon damage on an 8 s cooldown, Maelstrom Weapon procs favour slow weapons and feed one cast each, and Mental Dexterity turns less Intellect into attack power.

items.title: Wild Growth: double healing, no casting on the move
items.text: Restoration druids' Wild Growth heals twice as much since 13 Nov but can't be cast while moving.

items.title: Shadow priest party support cut
items.text: Vampiric Embrace heals the party for half as much (the priest gets double), and Dark Inspiration no longer stacks across shadow priests.

items.title: Paladin tanks: spell power is the damage stat
items.text: The Soulforge tank set swapped Strength for Intellect and spell power, and Blizzard says spell power is meant to drive the paladin tank's damage.

items.title: Paladin judgements count as ranged
items.text: Judgements use ranged hit and don't proc melee effects, except Judgement of Command, which counts as melee.

items.title: Warrior: Heroic Strike and Cleave keep Flurry
items.text: Cleave and Heroic Strike now trigger Unbridled Wrath and Reckless Swings without eating Flurry charges, and Berserker Rage breaks Sap.

items.title: Frost Nova breaks on Blizzard and procs
items.text: A mage's Frost Nova now breaks from proc damage and from Blizzard, so don't Blizzard what you just rooted.

items.title: Hunter Volley changes
items.text: Volley no longer triggers procs and stops when the hunter moves.

items.title: PvP rank now comes from rank points
items.text: Honor no longer sets your PvP rank: rank points from weekly battlegrounds and the Season Journey quest do, and Honor is spent on the rewards your rank unlocks.

items.title: Auction House deposits by duration
items.text: Faction Auction House deposits are now 5%, 20% or 60% of the vendor price for 2, 8 or 24 hours.

items.title: Blackmaw Hold loot bug fixed
items.text: Ordinary Blackmaw Hold mobs dropped elite loot until a 16 Nov hotfix; Blizzard took the gold back from deliberate farmers.

items.title: City world buffs end on death
items.text: Might of Stormwind and Warchief's Blessing now end when you die and no longer apply to pets or other non-players.

items.title: Channeler's Ring gets spell power
items.text: Channeler's Ring trades Spirit for spell power, and a Blessed Band of Light can be swapped for it at Pix Xizzix.

items.title: The level cap stays at 60
items.text: The developers say the cap won't go up and they want to avoid catch-up systems.

items.title: Vorsha the Lasher disabled
items.text: The Ashenvale quest Vorsha the Lasher is switched off until a crash is fixed, and a cauldron near Roogug in Razorfen Kraul can trap you.

items.title: Three raids open on 9 Dec
items.text: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open on 9 Dec with weekly lockouts; only Onyxia needs an attunement.

event.name: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open
event.changes: The first level-60 raids: weekly lockouts, new tier pieces and chase items; Onyxia's Lair needs the Drakefire Amulet in your bags.

items.title: Hardcore ruleset this winter
items.text: Hardcore arrives after launch, planned for winter with no day announced.

event.name: Hardcore ruleset
event.changes: A permanent-death ruleset; its characters don't share battlegrounds or progress with the others.

items.title: Spring 2027: two raids, two dungeons, a new area
items.text: Spring 2027 brings a 10- and a 20-player raid, two dungeons, a new area, a legendary questline and a PvP season refresh; no day yet.

event.name: Spring 2027 update
event.changes: New raids, dungeons and a zone at 60, and a new PvP season.

items.title: Summer 2027: a revamped classic raid
items.text: Summer 2027 brings a reworked classic raid, one new raid, two dungeons, more world content and profession and Legacy updates; no day yet.

event.name: Summer 2027 update
event.changes: More endgame raids and dungeons, and profession updates.

items.title: Scarlet Enclave is coming, some day
items.text: A developer confirmed the Scarlet Enclave raid and the Ashbringer story will come to Forever; no day or season given.

event.name: Scarlet Enclave raid
event.changes: A future raid with the Ashbringer story.
